title: Apollo Passive Seismic Experiment archive bundle

links.label: Apollo PSE station metadata in FDSN StationXML
Apollo PSE archive description, including section 3.3.4 Coordinate Systems

statements.text: NASA PDS Geosciences Node; Apollo Passive Seismic Experiment archive. Processing reference: Nunn, Weber and Bahia (2022), Planetary Science Journal 3, 219.
No licence text is published with the bundle. PDS asks that the most granular product used be cited.
statements.scope: Redistributed records and retained station geometry.

statements.text: The StationXML itself names no reference frame. The archive description states it: 'The coordinates of the stations on the Moon were redefined using high-resolution images from the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera Narrow Angle Camera, and are provided in the DE421 Mean Earth / Rotation Axis Reference Frame.'
statements.scope: Every ALSEP station longitude and latitude taken from this product.
statements.evidence: document/apollo_pse_description.pdf, section 3.3.4 Coordinate Systems, citing Wagner et al. (2017), Icarus 283, 92-103.

statements.text: The bundle covers the five passive-seismic stations S11, S12, S14, S15 and S16 only. The Apollo active seismic and lunar seismic profiling experiments are not in it.
statements.scope: Any claim about Apollo-era subsurface station coverage.
statements.evidence: data/xa/metadata/stationxml.xa.0.sxml, network XA, five Station elements.

statements.text: FDSN StationXML gives Elevation in metres; the element carries no unit attribute, so the unit comes from the schema rather than the archived file.
statements.scope: The elevation retained as each station's native coordinate.
statements.evidence: http://www.fdsn.org/xml/station/, cited by the product's own PDS4 label description.

publisher: NASA Planetary Data System Geosciences Node
